acceptance.given: A package declares runtime capabilities and provides local validation fixtures for those declarations.

oracle.expected: The validator result and diagnostics report only declaration presence and internal consistency of the package and its local fixtures, with no claim that prose or JSON enforces OS isolation, network policy, confirmation, or database recovery at runtime.
forbidden: Any validation claim that a declaration, prose statement, or JSON flag enforces OS isolation at runtime.
Any validation claim that a declaration, prose statement, or JSON flag enforces network policy at runtime.
Any validation claim that a declaration, prose statement, or JSON flag enforces confirmation at runtime.
Any validation claim that a declaration, prose statement, or JSON flag enforces database recovery at runtime.
oracle.observable: Inspect the structured validator result and diagnostics during package validation and verify that all reported claims are limited to declaration and local-fixture consistency.

acceptance.then: The validator output remains declaration-level and fixture-level, and explicitly avoids runtime-enforcement claims for the four capabilities.
acceptance.when: Run the package validator in its normal validation path and inspect the structured result and diagnostics.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A planned capability-boundary pytest case invokes the real validator on declarations and local fixtures, then asserts the structured result contains only declaration and fixture consistency claims and rejects any runtime-enforcement claim for OS isolation, network policy, confirmation, or database recovery.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain capability validation reporting to declaration presence and local-fixture consistency; prohibit claims that declarations enforce runtime OS isolation, network policy, confirmation, or database recovery.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the published validator result schema, declaration-level semantics, and existing package protocols; rollback only the capability-claim boundary changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validation claims transition from any broader runtime-safety implication to declaration and local-fixture consistency only.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The capability-boundary test passes against the real validator and its structured output contains no runtime-enforcement claim for the four excluded capabilities.
